weeklySauces.policy: Batch 10 sauces belong to their exact controlled recipes; no extra weekly sauce batch.

phases.title: 1. Confirm live counts
phases.detail: Use only active Batch 10 orders and exact tiers. No automatic family meals, extras, or fixed custom counts.

phases.title: 2. Raw protein and marinades
phases.detail: Apply the shared savory base to compatible whole thighs, split and label, then add each finish. Keep Halal Cart, Biryani, Peri Peri, breast and mince separate.

phases.title: 3. Produce and measured prep
phases.detail: Sanitize after raw proteins. Chop shared produce once, divide by recipe, then make cold sauces, dessert batches, and assembly kits.

phases.title: 4. Concurrent cooking
phases.detail: Start the long oven pans and bone-in chicken first. Run plain, yellow, Biryani, and vegetable rice as separate compatible groups while watched stovetop and griddle work proceeds. Cook shrimp last.

phases.title: 5. Weigh and assemble
phases.detail: Record actual cooked yields, portion by tier, keep cold components cold, and verify piece and side-cup counts.

phases.title: 6. Customer pack-out
phases.detail: Reconcile one complete customer bag at a time against the current order import and exact labels.
